verses.text: Of David. I will thank you with all my heart. I will sing praises to you in front of the gods.
I will bow down toward your holy temple and praise your name for your faithful love and your truth. You have made your name and your word greater than everything.
When I called, you answered me. You made me brave and strong.
All the kings of the earth will thank you, LORD, when they hear what you have said.
They will sing about the ways of the LORD, because the glory of the LORD is great.
Though the LORD is high above, he cares for humble people. But he knows proud people from far away.
Even when I walk through trouble, you keep me alive. You stretch out your hand against the anger of my enemies. Your right hand saves me.
The LORD will do everything he has planned for me. LORD, your faithful love lasts forever. Do not abandon what your own hands have made.
